criteria.deficiency: Minor, shared with the reference: duplicate-name navigation mixes two index spaces. activate_previous_tab uses the full list (patch.diff:527-530), so with [Tab("One","x"), Tab("Two","y"), Tab("Three","x")] active on "x", Left stays on "x" although the displayed order is x, y. activate_tab_by_number counts the full list (patch.diff:566-572).
